Calgry Fiddlers Welcome to Shetland

Nice tune and nice playing Tom, but it’s not The Calgary Fiddlers Welcome to Shetland!
As regards the versions above version in E is almost correct but there are quaver triplets instead of a crotchet in bars 1,3,5,7 in the first half. In the second half, in the second bar in both the first and second time bars the first crotchet should be quaver triplets.

↳ Posted by fiddler71 on June 14th, 2015.

Eh?

Not my playing or my submission! I was just correcting the dots to remove the chords!
